title.zh: 【香港投委会：代币化基金二级市场交易受与 ETF 类似的监管框架规管】
title.en: 【香港投委会：代币化基金二级市场交易受与 ETF 类似的监管框架规管】

current_state.zh: Hong Kong's IFEC guidance confirms that SFC-authorised tokenized funds can be bought and sold on the secondary market through licensed virtual asset trading platforms under an ETF-like regulatory framework, with two-way primary/secondary market interoperability and warnings about premium/discount, off-hours liquidity, price fragmentation and single-market-maker reliance.
current_state.en: Hong Kong's IFEC guidance confirms that SFC-authorised tokenized funds can be bought and sold on the secondary market through licensed virtual asset trading platforms under an ETF-like regulatory framework, with two-way primary/secondary market interoperability and warnings about premium/discount, off-hours liquidity, price fragmentation and single-market-maker reliance.
